articles.title: Driving value with an investor mindset
articles.summary: Long-term value creation is foundational to building strong companies and economies, yet many leaders struggle to ensure that well-conceived, well-executed strategies receive full recognition from investors. Senior Partner Ryan Davies and Associate Partner Jacob Marcus join us to discuss how to anticipate investor reactions, assess opportunities to outperform expectations, and embed an investor mindset into decision-making to build greater resilience.

articles.title: The untapped prize: Asia’s high-net-worth insurance market
articles.summary: The competition for Asia’s high-net-worth-individual market is underway. Insurers are well-placed to address evolving customer needs.

articles.title: Joseph Tsai: Putting customers at the heart of innovation
articles.summary: Joseph Tsai has reshaped Cathay United Bank by balancing innovation with a long-term view that consistently focuses on the customer.

articles.title: Improving private equity exit prospects
articles.summary: In today’s tougher exit environment, private equity firms are facing longer holding periods, valuation gaps, and increased pressure to return capital. Kai Vollhardt and Jelena Bauer are joined by Christian Habrich and Frederyk Schröder as they unpack their latest article on how to beat the exit odds. They share strategies top performing firms are using to improve exit outcomes and turn preparation into premium valuations, including how to translate AI potential into a credible value story.

articles.title: AI transformations run on trust
articles.summary: Technology may power AI transformation, but people determine whether it succeeds. Leaders can build trust through transparency, clarity, and investment in employees to create lasting change.
